why: I checked every verifier PASS/FAIL condition against its expect line. The behaviour checks (1–3) all run the program, so must_not item 2 is avoided. Item 1 is broken in two places. Check 3 requires the second run to write "an error naming missing.jsonl to stderr", but line 3 only says "error on stderr". That adds a requirement on what stderr says, which is the "exact stderr wording" kind of strictness the must_not list rules out. Check 6 requires "the PR is open", but line 6 only asks for one PR with the Closes body and green checks at its head. Under check 6, a PR that was merged before verification would fail even though line 6 holds. Builder steps such as "Edit only … jsonl-lint.js" are instructions to the builder, not PASS conditions, so I did not count them.
